diff --git a/libavutil/riscv/tx_float_rvv.S b/libavutil/riscv/tx_float_rvv.S
index 1ec51dc9de..c76f65babc 100644
--- a/libavutil/riscv/tx_float_rvv.S
+++ b/libavutil/riscv/tx_float_rvv.S
@@ -381,3 +381,136 @@ func ff_tx_fft16_ns_float_rvv, zve32f, zvl128b
         addi    sp, sp, 48
         ret
 endfunc
+
+// MDCT inverse, out of place. Mirrors the exact arithmetic of
+// ff_tx_mdct_inv() in tx_template.c:
+//   loop 1 (folding + pre-twiddle): for i in [0, len2)
+//       k = s->map[i] (already <<= 1 for the inverse path)
+//       tmp = { in2[-k*stride], in1[k*stride] }
+//       z[i] = CMUL3(tmp, s->exp[i])
+//   sub-FFT: s->fn[0](&s->sub[0], z, z, sizeof(TXComplex))
+//   loop 2 (post-twiddle): for i in [0, len4)
+//       i0 = len4+i, i1 = len4-i-1
+//       src1 = { z[i1].im, z[i1].re }; src0 = { z[i0].im, z[i0].re }
+//       CMUL(z[i1].re, z[i0].im, src1, exp[len2+i1].im, exp[len2+i1].re)
+//       CMUL(z[i0].re, z[i1].im, src0, exp[len2+i0].im, exp[len2+i0].re)
+// The strided loads/stores walk the i1 mirror pair downwards, so each
+// vector iteration covers vl consecutive (i0, i1) pairs.
+//
+// Signature (av_tx_fn): (AVTXContext *s, void *dst, void *src, ptrdiff_t stride)
+//   a0 = s, a1 = dst (z), a2 = src, a3 = stride (bytes)
+func ff_tx_mdct_inv_float_rvv, zve32f, zvl128b
+        lpad    0
+        lw      a4, 0(a0)               // s->len
+        ld      a5, 16(a0)              // s->exp
+        ld      a6, 8(a0)               // s->map
+        srai    a4, a4, 1               // len2
+        srai    t1, a3, 2               // stride in TXSample units
+        slli    t3, a4, 1               // 2*len2
+        addi    t3, t3, -1              // 2*len2 - 1
+        mul     t3, t3, t1              // c = (2*len2-1)*stride
+
+        addi    sp, sp, -32
+        sd      ra, 0(sp)
+        sd      s0, 8(sp)
+        sd      s1, 16(sp)
+        sd      s2, 24(sp)
+        mv      s0, a1                  // z base (kept across the sub-FFT call)
+        mv      s1, a0                  // s
+        mv      s2, a1                  // advancing z pointer (loop 1)
+
+        // ---- loop 1: folding + pre-twiddle ----
+        // tmp.re = in2[-k*stride] = src[(2*len2-1-k)*stride] (vluxei32, 4B elems)
+        // tmp.im = in1[k*stride]   = src[k*stride]
+        // z[i]   = CMUL3(tmp, exp[i])
+1:
+        vsetvli t2, a4, e32, m1, ta, ma // vl = min(remaining len2, VLMAX)
+        vle32.v v2, (a6)                // k = s->map[i..]
+        vmul.vx v3, v2, t1              // k*stride
+        vmv.v.x v4, t3                  // c
+        vsub.vv v4, v4, v3              // (2*len2-1-k)*stride (re index)
+        vluxei32.v v6, (a2), v4         // tmp.re
+        vluxei32.v v7, (a2), v3         // tmp.im
+        vlseg2e32.v v8, (a5)            // exp[i] -> v8 re, v9 im
+        vfmul.vv v10, v6, v8            // re*er
+        vfmul.vv v11, v7, v9            // im*ei
+        vfsub.vv v12, v10, v11          // z[i].re
+        vfmul.vv v10, v6, v9            // re*ei
+        vfmul.vv v11, v7, v8            // im*er
+        vfadd.vv v13, v10, v11          // z[i].im
+        vsseg2e32.v v12, (s2)           // z[i] = (re, im) interleaved
+        slli    t4, t2, 3               // vl*8
+        add     s2, s2, t4              // z += vl complex
+        add     a5, a5, t4              // exp += vl complex
+        slli    t4, t2, 2               // vl*4
+        add     a6, a6, t4              // map += vl ints
+        sub     a4, a4, t2              // remaining -= vl
+        bnez    a4, 1b
+
+        // ---- sub-FFT: s->fn[0](&s->sub[0], z, z, sizeof(TXComplex)) ----
+        ld      t0, 40(s1)              // s->fn[0]
+        ld      a0, 32(s1)              // &s->sub[0]
+        mv      a1, s0
+        mv      a2, s0
+        li      a3, 8
+        jalr    t0
+
+        // ---- loop 2: post-twiddle ----
+        lw      a4, 0(s1)               // s->len
+        srai    a4, a4, 1               // len2
+        srai    t0, a4, 1               // len4 (remaining counter)
+        ld      a5, 16(s1)              // s->exp
+        slli    t6, a4, 3               // len2*8
+        add     a5, a5, t6              // exp2 = s->exp + len2
+        slli    t6, t0, 3               // len4*8
+        add     t1, s0, t6              // p_z0 = z + len4*8        (+vl*8/iter)
+        addi    t2, t1, -8              // p_z1 = z + (len4-1)*8     (-vl*8/iter)
+        slli    t6, t0, 3
+        add     t3, a5, t6              // p_e0 = exp2 + len4*8      (+vl*8/iter)
+        addi    t4, t3, -8              // p_e1 = exp2 + (len4-1)*8  (-vl*8/iter)
+        li      t5, -8                  // byte stride for the mirror walk
+        beqz    t0, 3f
+2:
+        vsetvli t6, t0, e32, m1, ta, ma // vl pairs
+        vlseg2e32.v v2, (t1)            // v2 = z[i0].re, v3 = z[i0].im
+        vlse32.v  v1, (t2), t5          // b1 = z[i1].re
+        addi    a6, t2, 4
+        vlse32.v  v0, (a6), t5          // a1 = z[i1].im
+        vlseg2e32.v v6, (t3)            // v6 = exp2[i0].re, v7 = exp2[i0].im
+        vlse32.v  v5, (t4), t5          // d1 = exp2[i1].re
+        addi    a6, t4, 4
+        vlse32.v  v4, (a6), t5          // c1 = exp2[i1].im
+        // outA = (a1*c1 - b1*d1, a1*d1 + b1*c1)  -> z[i1].re, z[i0].im
+        vfmul.vv v8, v0, v4
+        vfmul.vv v9, v1, v5
+        vfsub.vv v10, v8, v9            // outA_re
+        vfmul.vv v8, v0, v5
+        vfmul.vv v9, v1, v4
+        vfadd.vv v13, v8, v9            // outA_im
+        // outB = (a0*c0 - b0*d0, a0*d0 + b0*c0)  -> z[i0].re, z[i1].im
+        vfmul.vv v8, v3, v7
+        vfmul.vv v9, v2, v6
+        vfsub.vv v12, v8, v9            // outB_re
+        vfmul.vv v8, v3, v6
+        vfmul.vv v9, v2, v7
+        vfadd.vv v14, v8, v9            // outB_im
+        vsseg2e32.v v12, (t1)           // z[i0] = (outB_re, outA_im)
+        vsse32.v  v10, (t2), t5         // z[i1].re = outA_re
+        addi    a6, t2, 4
+        vsse32.v  v14, (a6), t5         // z[i1].im = outB_im
+        mv      s2, t6                  // save vl
+        slli    t6, s2, 3               // vl*8
+        add     t1, t1, t6
+        sub     t2, t2, t6
+        add     t3, t3, t6
+        sub     t4, t4, t6
+        sub     t0, t0, s2              // remaining -= vl
+        bnez    t0, 2b
+3:
+        ld      ra, 0(sp)
+        ld      s0, 8(sp)
+        ld      s1, 16(sp)
+        ld      s2, 24(sp)
+        addi    sp, sp, 32
+        ret
+endfunc
